name: A Strange Piece of Scrap cannot be shared, so no receiver is stuck without the item (#13107)
contract: #13107: a shared Goblin Salvage quest could not be done by the receiver, 'probably because they need to have quest item in their inventory'. 176000 'A Strange Piece of Scrap' (rev_20261023_50_goblin_salvage_project.sql) is started by item 9707001 and requires that item, and a negated condition stops 9707001 from dropping while 176000 is active, yet it carried QUEST_FLAGS_SHARABLE (8): a receiver who accepted it could never complete it. Every stock quest that requires its own start item is non-sharable. 176011 itself is not changed: a receiver can only take it with 176000 rewarded and its three items are quest loot open to any holder. The fix clears flag 8 on 176000. Two grouped Horde players stand together; the sharer carries 176000 and the stock sharable quest 583 'Welcome to the Jungle'. The sharer shares each (CMSG_PUSHQUESTTOPARTY) and the receiver answers with the CMSG_QUESTGIVER_ACCEPT_QUEST a client sends for a shared quest, naming the sharer; WorldSession::HandleQuestgiverAcceptQuestOpcode accepts it only while the sharer can share the quest. CONTROL: 583 is accepted (status 1: it has no objectives, so it completes at once), so sharing and accepting work here. With the old flag 176000 is accepted the same way; with the fix the receiver must not carry it (status 0).

steps.label: SETUP: the two players are grouped
SETUP: the sharer carries 583 'Welcome to the Jungle'
SETUP: the sharer carries 176000 'A Strange Piece of Scrap'
CONTROL: share 583, a stock sharable quest
CONTROL: the receiver accepts the shared 583
CONTROL: the receiver now carries 583, so sharing works here
DISCRIMINATING: the receiver does not carry 176000, which it could never complete
